description: This file defines the interface for the dm_easy_mesh_agent_t class, a specialized agent derived from dm_easy_mesh_t, responsible for processing various WiFi mesh events, commands, and configurations. It includes method declarations for analyzing device initialization, station lists, auto-configuration, translating data models, handling WiFi protocol events such as BTM, CSA, beacon reports, and managing subdocument refreshes. The class also provides static methods for applying webconfig settings and constructor/destructor for lifecycle management.

classes.name: dm_easy_mesh_agent_t
classes.description: A class extending dm_easy_mesh_t, acting as an agent for processing WiFi mesh protocol events, commands, and configurations in an EasyMesh environment.

methods.name: analyze_dev_init
methods.description: Analyzes device initialization event and command.

methods.name: analyze_sta_list
methods.description: Processes the station list based on the given event and command.

methods.name: analyze_autoconfig_renew
methods.description: Processes auto-configuration renewal events and commands.

methods.name: translate_and_decode_onewifi_subdoc
methods.description: Translates and decodes OneWiFi subdocuments like AP, radio, client stats.

methods.name: analyze_m2ctrl_configuration
methods.description: Analyzes M2 control configuration with event, descriptor, and bus handle.

methods.name: analyze_csa_beacon_frame
methods.description: Processes CSA beacon frame received events.

methods.name: analyze_scan_result
methods.description: Processes scan results from event bus.

methods.name: analyze_set_policy
methods.description: Analyzes and sets policy based on event and bus description.

methods.name: refresh_onewifi_subdoc
methods.description: Refreshes the OneWiFi subdocument with optional M2 configuration and policy parameters.
